historical_reviews.deepseek: The passive direction is reasonable, but a literal range label does not prove the five individual sensor records and the command exposes the password in process arguments. The capped fallback and absent Web evidence are incomplete.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly rejects inference of FH/chip semantics and forbids log clearing or BMC/threshold/chip-control writes. This review adds physical assembly and monitored-chip provenance.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code exists, so neither an adjacent sensor row nor another variant can establish FH11-through-FH15 identity or coverage.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 requires every range member, ED-36 treats physical topology and sensor semantics as readiness inputs, and ED-38 protects logs and reserves the verdict for the engineer.

original_test_intent: Validate the chip-temperature reading associated with each of FH11, FH12, FH13, FH14 and FH15, proving the correct physical assembly, monitored chip, readable value and enabled thresholds in raw BMC evidence and both Web views.
original_method: The platform owner maps each FH11-through-FH15 label to its physical assembly and monitored chip, defines the sensor source and limits, and supplies exact BMC/Web mappings; automation then performs passive complete per-member collection for engineer confirmation.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner identifies FH11 through FH15, the chip monitored at each location, the sensing mechanism and approved limits, then confirms both BMC-Web entries. No thermal stimulus, chip control or log clear is authorized.
required_inputs: Authoritative meaning of FH and exact FH11-through-FH15 physical assembly/board/slot mapping
Monitored chip vendor/PN/revision/function and physical location for each member
Sensor source as chip on-die telemetry, external probe or board-controller estimate
Exact SDR name/record/entity and Dashboard/Server Health mapping per member
Units, scaling, accuracy/tolerance, polling/freshness and unavailable-state semantics
Approved normal range and enabled non-critical/critical/non-recoverable thresholds under documented load, cooling and ambient state
BMC/SDR/board/chip firmware and thermal specification revisions
Secret-safe collection, full evidence retention and independent BMC/thermal recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not expand FH beyond the literal five members FH11, FH12, FH13, FH14 and FH15 or infer what FH denotes
Bind each sensor to a physical assembly and a specific monitored chip; do not accept label similarity as provenance
Distinguish on-die telemetry from an external or proxy temperature because accuracy and limits differ
Retain the complete SDR and every enabled threshold; no 100-line truncation
Do not create artificial thermal load, alter cooling, clear logs, write thresholds, control the chip, flash firmware or reset BMC
Stop on missing/stale/invalid data, threshold mismatch, unsafe rise, cooling fault or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity and the owner-approved five-member topology
Capture complete read-only SDR/Sensor inventory and exact FH11-through-FH15 chip records
Parse value, units, state, freshness, enabled thresholds and sensing provenance
Prepare matching Dashboard and Server Health entries for each member
Correlate passive cooling, thermal, SEL and BMC health evidence
Perform no thermal stimulus, chip/cooling/threshold control or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve FH meaning, physical member mapping and monitored chip identities
Provide sensing-source semantics and chip-specific limits/thresholds
Confirm both Web mappings and missing/unsupported handling
Review all five results with cooling/ambient context and issue the overall decision

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only exact queries are useful only after names are resolved; 'TEMP_FH11~15_Chip' does not enumerate five sensors, the fallback is incomplete, credentials are exposed and physical chip/Web provenance is absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through secret-safe OOB access, retain the full SDR inventory and query each owner-mapped FH11-through-FH15 chip record separately, preserving threshold flags and provenance, then reconcile each channel in Dashboard and Server Health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FH11~15_Chip scope, two Web paths, reading/threshold criterion and 1/1-minute estimates remain; FH meaning, chip identities and thresholds are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES FH/CHIP TOPOLOGY, SENSOR SEMANTICS AND THRESHOLD PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a five-row physical-FH-to-chip sensor matrix, collect passive complete raw evidence and reconcile enabled thresholds across both Web views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Converts the range shorthand into five exact members and adds physical chip and sensing-source provenance without expanding test scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One literal result, a generic SDR excerpt or evidence from a neighboring temperature row cannot prove five chip sensors or their thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readback is passive, but a proxy/on-die mix-up or wrong assembly mapping can conceal a local thermal fault.

project_override_considerations: An unpopulated FH location or a design using one shared probe requires an explicit applicability and coverage rule. A shared value may cover multiple members only when a versioned owner mapping explains the physical relationship and common thresholds.
expected_evidence: FH11-through-FH15 physical assembly and monitored-chip PN/function/location matrix
Per-member sensing source, exact SDR/entity and both Web mappings
Value, units, state, freshness and enabled-threshold table with chip-specific limits
Complete redacted SDR plus five exact member outputs with status/timestamps
Dashboard and Server Health evidence per member
Passive cooling/ambient/SEL/BMC context and missing/stale/proxy analysis

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets FH11-through-FH15 chip temperatures and Web thresholds. Undefined FH topology, chip identities and expected values are incomplete project data rather than contradictory instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive temperature-validation path is identifiable. FH topology, monitored-chip mapping, sensing semantics and limits are supplyable readiness inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds an exact five-member interpretation, physical chip and on-die/proxy provenance, and prevents a literal range query or truncated inventory from substituting for complete evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A temperature number is actionable only when tied to the actual heat source and measurement point. An on-die junction sensor and a nearby board probe can legitimately report different values and require different thresholds. FH11 through FH15 contains five members, and firmware naming or shared probes can make simple label expansion unreliable without the owner topology.
